Changes in tesseract-ocr:

- Update to version 5.5.3 (sync with Factory):
  * CVE-2026-73067: heap out-of-bounds read in SquishedDawg on crafted model (boo#1275623)
  * CVE-2026-88047: stack buffer overflow in Classify::ReadNormProtos on crafted traineddata (boo#1280925)
  * CVE-2026-88048: heap out-of-bounds write/read in FullyConnected::Forward via dimension mismatch (boo#1280929)
  * CVE-2026-88049: heap out-of-bounds write in LSTM::Forward via na_/gate-matrix dimension mismatch (boo#1280930)
  * CVE-2026-88050: out-of-bounds write in UnicharCompress via unvalidated recoder code values (boo#1280931)
  * CVE-2026-88051: heap out-of-bounds write in GenericVector<T>::read via reserved/size_used_ mismatch
    (boo#1280932)
  * CVE-2026-88052: heap out-of-bounds write in UNICHARSET::load_via_fgets via count/insert
    desynchronization (boo#1280933)
  * CVE-2026-88053: heap out-of-bounds write in Classify::ReadIntTemplates via unvalidated counts in
    crafted traineddata (boo#1280934)
  * CVE-2026-88054: denial of service via empty-stack dereference at model load (boo#1280935)
